sql: SELECT "player_award_vote"."player_id" AS e, AVG((CAST(("player_award_vote"."points_won" - "player_award_vote"."points_max") AS REAL) / "player_award_vote"."points_max")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "player_award_vote" GROUP BY "player_award_vote"."player_id" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: player_award_vote.relative difference of voting points won from maximum possible points
why: (voting points won - maximum possible points) / maximum possible points: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of voting points won from maximum possible points per player (by player_id)

sql: SELECT "home_game"."park_id" AS e, AVG((CAST(("home_game"."openings" - "home_game"."games") AS REAL) / "home_game"."games")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "home_game" GROUP BY "home_game"."park_id" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: home_game.relative difference of home openings (dates with games) from home games
why: (home openings (dates with games) - home games) / home games: the relative difference of two quantities in count
average of relative difference of home openings (dates with games) from home games per park (by park_id)

sql: SELECT "park"."state" AS g, AVG((CAST(("home_game"."attendance" - "home_game"."games") AS REAL) / "home_game"."games")) AS m1 FROM "home_game" JOIN "park" ON "park"."park_id" = "home_game"."park_id" GROUP BY "park"."state"
quantities: home_game.relative difference of total attendance from home games
why: (total attendance - home games) / home games: the relative difference of two quantities in count
average of relative difference of total attendance from home games per park.state

sql: SELECT "appearances"."player_id" AS e, SUM(("appearances"."g_1b" - "appearances"."g_cf")) AS m1, AVG(("appearances"."g_lf" - "appearances"."gs")) AS m2, (SUM(("appearances"."g_1b" - "appearances"."g_cf")) - AVG(("appearances"."g_lf" - "appearances"."gs"))) AS m3 FROM "appearances" GROUP BY "appearances"."player_id" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: appearances.games at first base minus games in center field
appearances.games in left field minus games started
why: games at first base - games in center field: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same player-team-season
total of games at first base minus games in center field per player (by player_id) (additive)
games in left field - games started: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same player-team-season
average of games in left field minus games started per player (by player_id)
total of games at first base minus games in center field minus average of games in left field minus games started: both in count, of the same kind, from different quantities

sql: SELECT "manager"."team_id" AS e, SUM("manager"."w") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("manager"."l" - "manager"."g") AS REAL) / "manager"."g")) AS m2 FROM "manager" GROUP BY "manager"."team_id" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: manager.relative difference of losses from games managed
why: total of wins per team (by team_id) (additive)
(losses - games managed) / games managed: the relative difference of two quantities in count
average of relative difference of losses from games managed per team (by team_id)
